title: A plain scalar set to a string with a line break becomes double-quoted
notes: A plain scalar can hold a line break only by folding it, and the value must read back exactly, so the plain style cannot stay. YAML allows several styles for the new text (double-quoted, single-quoted with a blank line, a literal or folded block). The kit chooses double quotes with the `\n` escape: the text stays on the line of the key and nothing else in the document moves. This is a convention shared by the family, not a rule of the specification.
